LanguageData.FH_LostSpike_Paraspike.label: lost spike
LanguageData.FH_LostSpike_Paraspike.description: The paraspike has lost the core spike it needs to sustain itself. If it cannot recover, it will wither and die.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fingerspike.label: fingerspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fingerspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a fingerspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host grows a bony tentacle that deals stabbing damage.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Gutspike.label: gutspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Gutspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a gutspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host is almost immune to food poisoning, and gains immunity to gut worms while purging existing infestations.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Paraspike.label: paraspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Paraspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a paraspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nBleeding is reduced and wound infections are prevented. Offspring inherit this parasitism.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Puffspike.label: puffspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Puffspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a puffspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host is immune to asthma and lung rot, which are cured from its lungs. It moves faster and tolerates toxic environments better.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shatterspike.label: shatterspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shatterspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a shatterspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host grows a bone-burst tentacle capable of firing bone shards at range.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shieldspike.label: shieldspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shieldspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a shieldspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host gains stronger armor and a shield claw.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Toughspike.label: toughspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Toughspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a toughspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host grows two bony tentacles and gains improved global work speed.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Trispike.label: trispike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Trispike.description: This creature is parasitized by a trispike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host can release two random small fleshbeasts.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Whipspike.label: whipspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Whipspike.description: This creature is parasitized by a whipspike. The fleshbeast grants it additional abilities, but also imposes significant costs.\n\nThe host grows a fleshy whip tentacle capable of striking nearby enemies.
LanguageData.FH_Spike_Paraspike.label: paraspike's spike
LanguageData.FH_Spike_Paraspike.description: The paraspike's vital parasitic spike. It embeds in the host and continuously regulates flesh and blood.
